_README: Remote model catalogue for OwLLM Desktop. The app fetches this file at startup and merges it OVER the bundled defaults. To add a model the day it ships (e.g. Claude Opus 4.9) — add an entry under the right provider, commit, push. Every user gets it on next launch, no rebuild. Same id => replaces the bundled entry; new id => added to the top of that provider's list. Fields: id (exact API/CLI model id), display (label), sub (show subscription row), api (show API row), effort (array of reasoning tiers; Anthropic/OpenAI only).
